info.title: MatmoomPay API
info.description: Card payments for Sudanese businesses, compatible with the Thawani contract. Amounts are integers in whole Sudanese pounds (SDG). Every response uses the envelope {success, code, description, data}.

ApiKey.name: matmoom-api-key
ApiKey.description: Secret key: sk_test_ for test mode, sk_live_ for live mode.

Error.description: Error envelope. See the error table in the docs.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Send the same key when retrying a POST to get the original response instead of a second object (24 hours).

products.description: Required when mode is payment. The total must be at least the platform minimum (SDG 100).

customer_id.description: Required when mode is subscription; lets the payer use saved cards

metadata.description: Required; send {} when empty. Up to 50 keys.
